decisions.reason: The DPA management tool fits the firm's compliance-focused agency strategy, gets positive customer feedback, keeps its own page, and costs little to carry, so results appear to meet aspirations.
The hosting management platform is featured on the home page in both years and is central to the agency platform strategy, which signals satisfactory performance and no trigger for search.
The configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core business, keeps a dedicated page, and in a growing market likely meets aspirations with little extra resource burden.

Extended PHP security support has only a brief mention and is tied to aging PHP versions, but it supports the security promise and costs little, and growing industry turnover gives the slack to keep it for now.
